name: Ember
soul: The soul of one who gives off more than they keep, and has never worked out how to burn low.
spark: The mote is a point of orange that brightens when you breathe out. Cup your hands round it and they are warm.

hybrid.text: It is your field as fire, with nothing under it: it goes where your attention goes.

settled.name: Spark
settled.text: A coal's worth of fire with nothing under it, hanging at your shoulder. It goes where your attention goes, and has scorched the page you were reading.
settled.sign: A coal's worth of fire with nothing under it, at your shoulder. It brightens when you breathe out.
settled.habit: It drifts to whatever you are looking at and scorches it slightly.

paths.name: Kept Fire
paths.of: one who warms a whole room and lets nobody close enough to be burned
paths.text: It learned from you that a fire is best at a certain distance: near enough to warm, too far to burn. It keeps that distance exactly.
paths.sign: A steady flame the height of a hand, always the same two paces off. It moves back when you move in.
paths.habit: It settles in the middle of any group and keeps the same distance from each.

prongs.name: Camp-fire
prongs.of: one people gather round without deciding to
prongs.text: The party sits round it and it sits with the party. It is counted among the three now.
prongs.sign: A ring of scorched stones travels with it and sets itself down wherever it stops.
prongs.habit: It burns up a little when a third person joins, and down when one leaves.

finishes.name: Cohort Fire
finishes.of: one who holds a little of each friend
finishes.text: Twelve of you lit it together the first cold night. It burns a little for each, and dips when one is hurt.
finishes.sign: Twelve small tongues of flame stand in a crown, each a slightly different colour.
finishes.habit: One tongue dips now and then. It turns to face the dormitory that classmate sleeps in.

finishes.name: Traveller's Fire
finishes.of: one who is carried between strangers so that they are not strangers
finishes.text: It goes in a pot between you and the passenger. Nobody who was warm at it has been lost on the road.
finishes.sign: It rides in a pierced iron pot on a chain, and throws a lattice of light on whoever walks beside it.
finishes.habit: It burns toward the guest, whoever the guest is.

prongs.name: Circle-flame
prongs.of: one who decides where the dark stops
prongs.text: It keeps the dark at the edge of a circle and you inside the circle.
prongs.sign: The light it throws ends in a clean edge, like a line drawn on the ground. Two bright points in it watch the edge.
prongs.habit: It widens its circle by a pace when someone is late home.

finishes.name: The Fire That Stayed
finishes.of: one who was still there in the morning, every time
finishes.text: It has burned through every night you were afraid it would not. The posts along your line have started to copy it.
finishes.sign: A low old flame, more gold than orange, with the look of something that has seen many dawns.
finishes.habit: It burns lowest in the hour before light, and has never gone out in it.

finishes.name: Window-ember
finishes.of: one who keeps a light in the window for those not coming back
finishes.text: It burns in the hall's window for those not coming back. They come anyway, to look at it.
finishes.sign: A single ember behind glass, with a blue heart. Frost on the pane does not form near it.
finishes.habit: It sits on the sill facing out, all night, from the lamp hour on.

prongs.name: Tempering Flame
prongs.of: one who is made harder by what should have put them out
prongs.text: Each time you are hurt it burns a little hotter in you. You are harder to hurt than you were.
prongs.sign: A dark skin like fire-scale has formed over it, and the flame shows red at the cracks.
prongs.habit: It sits in the forge coals while they are worked, and comes out brighter.

finishes.name: Twice-lit
finishes.of: one who went out once and came back changed
finishes.text: It went out once, when you went down. It came back when you did, and has not been the same colour since.
finishes.sign: Its flame is a colour it was not before, and two thin wings of it stand up at the back.
finishes.habit: It gutters once, deliberately, each night, and catches again.

finishes.name: Slow Coal
finishes.of: one whose patience is hot to the touch
finishes.text: It sits in your guard arm. What strikes your guard finds the guard is hot.
finishes.sign: A coal banked behind plates of its own clinker. Heat comes off the plates in a slow shimmer.
finishes.habit: It sits in the crook of your guard arm and warms the joint before practice.

paths.name: Rushlight
paths.of: one who keeps a small light going where there is no reason to
paths.text: It learned from you to go on where there is no reason to. It is a small light, and it has been carried into worse places than it was made for.
paths.sign: A thin upright flame no bigger than a thumbnail. It does not lean in a draught.
paths.habit: It burns at the same height all night, whether or not anyone is in the room.

prongs.name: Cold Flame
prongs.of: one who can go on without any warmth coming back
prongs.text: In the Quiet it burns blue and gives no heat, and it is the one flame the Quiet cannot put out.
prongs.sign: It burns blue and gives no heat. You can pass a hand through it and feel nothing.
prongs.habit: It stands in the coldest corner of the room, does not warm it, and does not leave.

finishes.name: Mast-fire
finishes.of: one who stands at the front, where the dark water is
finishes.text: It stands on the prow over black water, and the river-things keep their distance from it.
finishes.sign: A blue-white flame that sits on the highest point of anything: a prow, a pole, a raised hand.
finishes.habit: It climbs to the top of whatever is tallest in the room and stands there.

finishes.name: Deep Ember
finishes.of: one who always knows which way is out
finishes.text: Carried into the heart of a zone, it leans toward the way out. When it stands straight, run.
finishes.sign: A red ember with two pale points in it. It leans, slightly, always the same way.
finishes.habit: It leans toward the door of any room it is in.

prongs.name: Study-flame
prongs.of: one who reads by their own light, late
prongs.text: Hold the thing to it and the old marks show. It has read more of the Archive's secrets than the archivists.
prongs.sign: It burns small and white over a page and has never singed one. Old ink shows up under it.
prongs.habit: It hangs over whatever you were last reading and waits for you to come back.

finishes.name: Palimpsest Fire
finishes.of: one who sees what was there before it was written over
finishes.text: It shows what was written under what was written. Some of it was about people like you.
finishes.sign: A ring of faint figures turns round it like a dial, in a hand nobody now uses.
finishes.habit: It passes slowly along old walls, and stops where there was once a door.

finishes.name: Seal-wax Flame
finishes.of: one who can tell when they are being lied to
finishes.text: It seals what you send and opens what you receive, and burns a different colour when a house is lying.
finishes.sign: It burns red as wax, with a drip that never falls. It goes green when someone in the room lies.
finishes.habit: It hovers over the post as it is sorted, and darkens at one letter.

prongs.name: Signal-flame
prongs.of: one who keeps talking to those too far away to answer
prongs.text: It speaks across distance in flashes to those you are bound to, and they have learned to read it.
prongs.sign: When it is alone it flashes long and short, with pauses left for a reply.
prongs.habit: It signals from the window toward the line each night, and waits.

finishes.name: Oath-fire
finishes.of: one whose word you can put your hand in
finishes.text: You swore with your hand in it. It did not burn you. It will, the day a Term is broken.
finishes.sign: A flame with a chain of darker fire coiled in it. It is cool to those who have kept faith.
finishes.habit: It burns over your hand when you rest it on the table, and does not hurt.

finishes.name: Running Fire
finishes.of: one who passes it on, and it is larger when it arrives
finishes.text: It runs down the chain of your Pattern from beat to beat, and each beat lands hotter than the last.
finishes.sign: It does not stay in one place but runs in a ring from point to point, brighter each lap.
finishes.habit: It lights every candle in the room in turn, and goes round again.

paths.name: Wildfire
paths.of: one who spends themselves all at once and is surprised to be tired
paths.text: It learned from you to spend the whole of itself at once. It is always surprised, afterward, to find that it is tired.
paths.sign: It burns ragged and too tall, streaming smoke, and is already leaning toward the next thing.
paths.habit: It burns down to almost nothing by evening, and is back at full height by breakfast.

prongs.name: Lash of Flame
prongs.of: one who throws themselves into whatever is nearest
prongs.text: It wraps your weapon and goes where the edge goes. What you cut stays lit.
prongs.sign: A long tongue of flame that wraps whatever you hold, and leaves a bright edge on it.
prongs.habit: It winds itself round the fire-irons, the bedpost, your wrist.

finishes.name: White Ember
finishes.of: one who burns hottest when closest
finishes.text: Close in, it burns without colour. Armour is a thing it has opinions about.
finishes.sign: At arm's length it is orange. Against your skin it is white, with no colour at all at the centre.
finishes.habit: It presses itself against cold iron until the iron ticks.

finishes.name: Kiln-breath
finishes.of: one whose heat goes into the work and stays there
finishes.text: It lives in what you build. Your conjured edges come out of the air already tempered.
finishes.sign: It lives in a small cage of turning wheels it built for itself, and breathes through the gaps.
finishes.habit: It breathes on what you have just made, and the piece rings when it cools.

prongs.name: Ember on the Shot
prongs.of: one who is gone as soon as they are pointed
prongs.text: It rides your shot and opens when it lands.
prongs.sign: Two short wings of flame, swept back, and a way of quivering on the hand before it goes.
prongs.habit: It darts to the far end of the corridor and back for no reason at all.

finishes.name: Ember Comet
finishes.of: one who arrives all at once and leaves a mark
finishes.text: A long tail across the dark and a hole where it stops. You only have to point.
finishes.sign: A hot white head and a long tail. A ring of light spreads wherever it stops.
finishes.habit: It draws one long line across the dark ceiling before it will settle.

finishes.name: Hill-fire
finishes.of: one who burns where it can be seen from the road
finishes.text: It burns on the height above a dark post, so the next car knows where the line still is.
finishes.sign: A beacon flame, tall and plain, in an iron basket. It can be seen from the next post.
finishes.habit: It answers any light it sees on the horizon with one flare, and waits for the answer.

prongs.name: Grass-fire
prongs.of: one whose enthusiasm gets away from them
prongs.text: Set down in the green it runs with the wind. Call it back before it forgets whose it is.
prongs.sign: A low wide flame that runs along the ground in a line and puts down runners.
prongs.habit: It creeps out along the floorboards toward the door when you are not watching, and comes back when called.

finishes.name: Burn-off
finishes.of: one who clears the ground so that the thing has to be faced
finishes.text: It burns the cover the pack hides in, upwind, and waits with you where they will come out.
finishes.sign: A wide mouth of flame, low to the ground, with black stubble behind it.
finishes.habit: It eats the dead leaves out of the gutters in autumn, neatly.

finishes.name: Fire-whirl
finishes.of: one who has met something that makes them more than they can manage
finishes.text: Fire and wind found each other over open ground. It walks on one foot and nothing stands near it.
finishes.sign: A turning column of flame on one foot, with the air standing clear and still round it.
finishes.habit: It spins slowly in the middle of the yard on windy days and will not come in.
